title: Generating health variables for a synthetic population of Santa Catarina, Brazil, via ensemble learning and a calibrated linear program
abstract: arXiv:2611.31726v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agent-based models in epidemiology require synthetic populations with health-related attributes, which in Brazil are available only from sample surveys such as the Pesquisa Nacional de Sa\'ude (PNS). We add health variables, including smoking, alcohol consumption, physical exercise, self-rated health and chronic conditions, to a georeferenced synthetic population of the state of Santa Catarina. Class probabilities are estimated by an ensemble of logistic regression, random forest and support vector machine, and individuals are assigned to classes by a linear program that reproduces the class proportions estimated from the survey. We show that, under a mild condition satisfied by our ensemble, the penalty term of this program is no longer needed, and the proportions are reproduced exactly. In a cross-validation on PNS data, the method attains the best results.

translated_title: 通过集成学习与校准线性规划为巴西圣卡塔琳娜州的合成人口生成健康变量
translated_abstract: 流行病学中的基于主体的模型需要带有健康相关属性的合成人口，而在巴西，这些属性只能通过诸如全国健康调查（Pesquisa Nacional de Saúde, PNS）之类的抽样调查获得。我们为圣卡塔琳娜州的地理参考合成人口添加了健康变量，包括吸烟、饮酒、体育锻炼、自评健康和慢性病。类别概率由逻辑回归、随机森林和支持向量机的集成方法进行估计，个体则由一个能够再现从调查中估计的类别比例的线性规划分配到相应类别。我们证明，在集成方法满足的一个温和条件下，该规划的惩罚项不再需要，且比例可以被精确再现。在基于PNS数据的交叉验证中，该方法取得了最佳结果。
tldr: 本文提出一种将逻辑回归、随机森林与支持向量机的集成学习与校准线性规划相结合的方法，为巴西圣卡塔琳娜州的合成人口生成吸烟、饮酒、锻炼、自评健康和慢性病等健康变量，并证明在温和条件下可省去惩罚项从而精确再现调查比例，在PNS数据交叉验证中取得最佳效果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an ensemble of logistic regression, random forest, and support vector machines combined with a calibrated linear program to generate health variables (smoking, alcohol use, exercise, self-rated health, chronic conditions) for a synthetic population of Santa Catarina, Brazil, showing that under a mild condition the penalty term can be omitted to exactly reproduce survey proportions, achieving the best results in cross-validation on PNS data.
